name: coordinate
description: Deterministic coordination for concurrent Claude sessions contending over a shared mutable resource (a git tree, a dev database, a deploy lane, the Cloudflare WARP tunnel). Ships the resource-agnostic COORD protocol as two skills, a stdlib `coord` CLI that extracts the state machine into a flock-serialized shared ledger (claim/release/request/grant/deny/query/status with lease TTLs, priority preemption, and anti-starvation), a reachability-probe registry, three-layer dead-holder liveness (SessionEnd release for clean exit, connect-probe reaping for kill-9, TTL backstop), and a SessionEnd hook.
